meta.name: anndata
meta.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理单细胞分析的注释数据矩阵
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常处理单细胞RNA-seq数据或.h5ad文件。
copy.tagline_en: Manage annotated matrices for single-cell analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with single-cell RNA-seq data or .h5ad files.

howto.what: 装上该技能后,Claude 可将单细胞数据作为 AnnData 注释矩阵来创建、读取、写入。能处理 h5ad/zarr 文件,支持拼接、子集筛选、格式转换,并与 scanpy 等方法协作。
howto.when: 当用户提到 h5ad、zarr 文件,或要求创建/读写 AnnData 对象、拼接多个数据集时触发。

say.text: 读取 sample.h5ad,告诉我有多少细胞和基因。
用后援模式打开大文件,筛选质量分大于0.8的细胞。
say.note: 使用 backed='r' 模式,按 obs 条件子集。

say.text: 把 batch1、batch2 两个 h5ad 拼接,标注批次来源。
say.note: 用 ad.concat 并加 label 参数。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can create, read, and write AnnData objects for single-cell annotated matrices. It handles h5ad/zarr files, supports concatenation, subsetting, conversion, and integrates with tools like scanpy.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to work with h5ad/zarr files, create or modify AnnData objects, or concatenate multiple datasets.

say_en.text: Read sample.h5ad and tell me the number of cells and genes.
say_en.note: Claude reads the file and reports n_obs and n_vars.

say_en.text: Open the large file in backed mode and filter cells with quality score above 0.8.
say_en.note: Uses backed='r' mode and subsets by obs condition.

say_en.text: Concatenate batch1 and batch2 h5ad files, labeling the batch source.
say_en.note: Uses ad.concat with a label parameter.
